{{Quote|What he wanted was to make a living and keep a roof over our heads. And you took advantage&mdash;you paid him to get himself killed!|Lin, speaking about Bellis, to the sergeant|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Bellis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Lin]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist War]] started by a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] attempting to overthrow the planet's [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]], Bellis and Lin lived in a [[Bellis's house|house]] in [[Talloran village]], a small [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the island of [[Avilatan]]. After the Separatists captured the village, Bellis [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on them for the Republic.

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], the Separatists stole a powerful [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] from the Republic&mdash;prompting the [[Republic Army|Republic forces]] on the planet to ask for Bellis's help in uncovering the bomb's location. Ultimately, he was able to determine that the bomb was housed in a [[Separatist Base|supply outpost]] on the small island of [[Mannett Point]]. After placing the information in his [[field box]], Bellis contacted the Republic forces in order to set up a meeting so that he could give them the information. In response, the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] known as [[Havoc Squad]] [[Mission to Talloran village (Havoc Squad)|sent]] a newly-recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] to meet with Bellis in Talloran village. However, Bellis was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Separatists before the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] arrived, although the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was still able to retrieve the field box from Bellis's wife.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Bellis reported making an important discovery, but he's in too deep to exfiltrate for a full report. Instead, you'll rendezvous with Bellis in a nearby village called Talloran.|Commander Harron Tavus, assigning the sergeant to meet with Bellis|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Lin-TOR.png|thumb|left|180px|Bellis's wife, Lin]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Bellis was alive during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At some point during his life, Bellis [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a Human female named [[Lin]], with whom he lived in a two-story [[Bellis's house|house]] in [[Talloran village]], a small settlement located on [[Avilatan]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. While Bellis and Lin lived on the planet, a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] started a conflict<ref name="TOR" /> known as the [[Separatist War]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identfied the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> in rebellion against the Republic and [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Ord Mantell's government]] in an attempt to take control of the planet.<ref name="TOR" /> Bellis's home village of Talloran was the first that the Separatists took over on Avilatan,<ref name="TalloranCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Talloran village}}</ref> and they ultimately barricaded it to defend against Republic counterattacks.<ref name="TOR" />

During that time, Bellis worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Republic and reported on Separatist activities to [[Republic Army|Republic forces]] at [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic base located near Talloran village. While working as a spy for the Republic, Bellis and his wife stayed in their home, where Bellis stored his [[field box]], a type of container used by Republic [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to store important uncovered information. Bellis risked his life for the Republic many times in order to provide intelligence on Separatist activities. He always met with Republic forces in person, due to the fact that the Separatists could monitor nearby [[Comlink/Legends|communications]] with [[signal tapper]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Separatists stole a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] from the Republic, which prompted the Republic to try to locate where the Separatists had hidden the powerful weapon. Bellis was one of several individuals on whom the Republic called for aid, and he was able to determine that the bomb had been taken to a Separatist-controlled [[Separatist Base|supply outpost]] on [[Mannett Point]], a small island off Avilatan's coast. After he found out the information, Bellis encoded it and placed it in his field box before informing the Republic that he had learned of the weapon's location. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harron Tavus]], the leader of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] known as [[Havoc Squad]], arranged for his squad's newly-recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] to [[Mission to Talloran village (Havoc Squad)|meet]] with Bellis in a small alley in Talloran village in order to obtain the information, since Bellis could not leave the village due to it being controlled by the Separatists. Before the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was able to arrive, Bellis was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Separatists&mdash;forcing the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to go to Bellis's house to retrieve the information from his field box. Upon learning of Bellis's death, Lin was greatly upset and refused to give the field box to the sergeant, but she eventually relented, allowing the sergeant to take Bellis's information back to [[Fortress/Legends|Fort]] Garnik.<ref name="TOR" /> There, Republic forces reviewed Bellis's findings and prepared a [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|mission]] to infiltrate the supply outpost on Mannett Point to recapture the bomb.<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Ambush|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh no. No, no, no, not Bellis! He can't be dead! No! Bellis risked his life every day for you, and now you've gone and gotten him killed! My poor, sweet Bellis&hellip;|Lin, to a Republic trooper|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Bellis had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and tan skin. At the time of his death, Bellis was wearing gray and white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with gray [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and black knee-high [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. According to his wife, Lin, Bellis was a good man, and his main motivations for helping the Republic during the war on Ord Mantell were to make a living to provide for his wife and himself. Upon learning of his death, his wife expressed her grief at losing him as well as her anger at the soldier and Republic that had failed to protect Bellis. As a spy, Bellis was able to uncover information on the whereabouts of the lost orbital strike bomb, and he followed standard procedure for Republic agents by encoding important information and storing it in his field box.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bellis first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is featured in "The Spy," an early quest available on the planet Ord Mantell for players of the [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] class. In the quest, the player goes to Talloran village to meet with Bellis but finds his body instead. The player completes the mission by going to Bellis's house, where the player obtains the field box from Bellis's wife, Lin.<ref name="TOR" /> Bellis's findings are revealed at the end of "The Ambush," the Trooper quest that occurs immediately afterward.<ref name="TOR2" /> The model used for Bellis's corpse is the same<ref name="TOR" /> as Imperial [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Ralan]], who had [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with the crest of the Sith Empire on each shoulder.<ref name="Ralan">{{TORcite|type=class|Agent|Chaos on a Broken World|Taris}}</ref> However, the game provides no reason for the Republic agent to be wearing the Imperial symbols.<ref name="ImperialSymbol">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Spy|Ord Mantell}} had Bellis wearing [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with symbols that were identified as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] throughout the game.</ref> Bellis's location is also marked on a map in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', with an indicator for "The Spy."<ref name="explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
